# Build interaction matrix

Baseline: ff0ee5963688bf488d2635d66a4bc9382aa7ac2a, Verification #88 and Vercel successful. This document distinguishes the audited baseline from the implemented behavior. The exhaustive source declaration inventory is BUILD_CONTROL_INVENTORY.json, generated by `node scripts/build-controls.mjs`; repeated registry controls retain their declaration plus dynamic data source. No destructive controls are clicked by the generic audit.

Provider health is never inferred from configuration. A successful OpenAI model-list probe establishes endpoint access only; it does not establish generation. Hosted read-only checkout, deployment metadata, and paired local machine facts remain separate. Advanced surfaces without implemented adapters stay visibly unavailable.
